newsitem.title: USA: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates fell in wk ending 7/11.
newsitem.headline: US 30-,15-yr mortgage rates fell in wk ending 7/11.

text.p: Average commitment rates on U.S. 30- and 15-year fixed-rate mortgages fell during the week ending July 11, Freddie Mac said Thursday.
Thirty-year mortgages fell 15 basis points in the week to an average 7.47 percent from 7.62 percent the prior week.
Fifteen-year mortgages fell to an average 7.01 percent from 7.15 percent, Freddie Mac reported.
One-year adjustable rate mortgages also fell, declining to 5.53 percent in the week from 5.67 last week.
A year ago, the 30-year rate averaged 8.42 percent, the 15-year 7.93 percent and the ARM 6.01 percent.
